pages.text: The Basic Processor in Refined Storage 2 is the entry-level processor used to craft basic Refined Storage devices with improved efficiency. It is the foundation for more advanced processors and components, featuring enhanced power management and better processing capabilities.

Features:$(li)Used in basic device recipes$(li)Required for early-game automation$(li)Used in storage and network components$(li)Can be upgraded to Improved Processor$(li)Enhanced power efficiency$(li)Better processing speed

To craft the Basic Processor:$(li)First craft a Raw Basic Processor$(li)Smelt the Raw Basic Processor in a furnace$(li)Combine with Processor Binding$(li)Requires basic resources$(li)Improved crafting process
